en: Sepia-toned postcard showing the ruins of a Byzantine church complex on a rocky hillside. The structure has partially collapsed walls, arched windows and doorways, and a distinctive dome with Byzantine brickwork. Printed captions in several languages appear along the bottom border, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is overlaid on the image. In the upper right corner, handwritten-style text identifies the site.
